tcg.title: Raikou ex SAR 108/076 M6 Storm Emeralda Japanese Pokemon Card Damaged
tcg.about: Raikou ex SAR 108/076 from the Japanese expansion pack M6 Storm Emeralda, a Special Art Rare full-art holo card with lightning artwork. HP 200, Lightning type, with the attacks that let you attach an Energy from your deck even on the first turn and the 200-damage Power Rush. Illustrated by Oku. This is a damaged copy: the printing and foil are scuffed around the ex Rule box at the lower right, and part of the rule text is partly rubbed away. The rest of the front and the back, including the corners and edges, looks clean in the photos. Sold as a damaged card at a reduced price; please see all photos. Offered as a single card.
tcg.why: A damaged Special Art Rare Raikou ex from M6 Storm Emeralda with full-art holo artwork.
tcg.perfect: Pokemon card collectors who want this card.
